mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for three consecutive months signals deep economic contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over two months signals consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production decline below 95.0 for two months signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% supports equity valuations through lower discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL change exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 9.5% and PAYEMS growth rate below 0.1% per month signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery, industrial production rebound above 95.0 for two months signals strengthening economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0 during post-shock recovery (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
